name: Video tile
oneLiner: a video tile (a thumbnail built from the brand's screen and a person cut-out, duration badge, title, channel row) pops in on glass, the view count races up, a glass play button lands with a ring on hover and a progress bar starts running along the bottom of the thumbnail
say: when the speaker mentions a video they made or saw ('I posted a video about it', 'that video did a million views'): the play ring lands on 'video', the count settles as they say the number
